Name: Stardew Messages - Starter Pack - Vanilla NPCs
Author: Jybee
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Stardew Messages - Starter Pack[/b][/size][/center]
[center][size=4]Vanilla NPC First Messages[/size][/center]
[center][i][size=4]The Core builds the phone. The Starter Pack gives it a soul… and NPCs who dare to text you first.[/size]
[/i][/center][quote]
[size=3]This mod is a [b]ready-to-play content pack[/b] for [b]Stardew Messages (Core)[/b].

It adds RP [b]“first contact”[/b] conversations for vanilla NPCs: short, lively messages that feel right at home in Stardew.
Everything is designed to make it feel like Pelican Town… actually has your number.[/size][/quote]
[b][size=4]
✅ What you get
[/size][/b][size=4][list]
[*][size=3]A first contact for every vanilla NPC - each one has their own tone and style.[/size]
[*][size=3]Interactive replies - pick your response, steer the vibe, and shape how the conversation unfolds.[/size]
[*][size=3]“Unknown Number” intros - the identity is revealed at the right moment (mystery + RP).[/size]
[*][size=3]Progressive pacing - messages blend into your playthrough (no instant spam).[/size]
[*][size=3]Optional MMS (gallery) - primarily with the bachelors & bachelorettes (marriage candidates), ready to display inside conversations.[/size]
[/list][/size][b][size=4][b][size=4]
🎁 Why you should grab it
[/size][/b][/size][/b][list]
[*][size=3]Because it’s the perfect way to start:[/size]
[*][size=3]Install, play… and your favorite NPCs stop waiting for “the right moment” to text you. 🙂[/size]
[*][size=3][i]Bonus:[/i] it’s [b]JSON-based[/b] - fully playable out of the box, easy to tweak, and a great starting point to create your own conversations and content.[/size]
[/list][b][size=4]
📦 Installation[/size][/b][list]
[*][size=3]Install first: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41918][b]Stardew Messages - SMS and MMS (Core)[/b][/url]﻿[b][/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Then install: [b]Starter Pack - Vanilla First Contact[/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Drop the folders into: [b]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Launch the game: messages will arrive naturally as you progress.[/size]
[/list][b][size=4]
📸 Preview[/size][/b]
